title: Motorcyclist spooked by huge hairy Bigfoot in Canada
excerpt: A motorcyclist was left spooked after spotted a seven foot tall Bigfoot covered in long grey and black hair during a trip in Canada.
content:
A motorcyclist was left spooked after spotted a "seven foot tall" Bigfoot covered in long "grey and black" hair during a trip in Canada.

Is Bigfoot lurking on Vancouver Island?

Carlos Serra claims to have seen a huge hairy beast walking along the side of a road in the early hours of the morning when he was travelling to his accommodation after arriving in Port Hardy on Vancouver Island via ferry on August 11, 2025.

Reporting the sighting to the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization, Carlos explained: "As I was travelling by motorcycle, I was one of the first off the ferry, if not the first ... I was very familiar with the area around Port Hardy ... [And] I was eager to get into Port Hardy before the hostel closed up.

"I turned right onto Highway 19, and did notice a vehicle, which I'm confident was from the ferry as well, also turn right. I rode the bike along a dark stretch of the single lane highway for just a couple of minutes when I saw something large walking in the opposite lane moving in the opposite direction.

"My very first thought was: 'What is a First Nations person doing walking in the middle of the road with a large fur coat?'"

Carlos stopped the motorcycle and saw the car behind him was flashing its lights - and he's convinced the other driver must have spotted the strange figure too.

He went on: "The vehicle behind me was about 75 meters back from my position and was flashing its lights. I thought to myself that it must flashing its lights at whatever that thing was walking in the opposite lane as the vehicle was too far from me to be flashing its lights at me.

"I also think it either slowed down or stopped to observe what was in the other lane."

Carlos suddenly realised he might have seen something very abnormal, adding: "It was round this time I asked myself if what I had just seen was a possible sasquatch, and then I also thought about driving the bike back towards the creature. I decided not to keep riding into Port Hardy."

After arriving at his accommodation, Carlos saw the same car which had been behind him on the road at the time of the sighting but the driver appeared too shaken to answer his questions.

He explained: "I decided to ask the fellow if he had noticed that 'guy' walking in the opposite lane of the highway. He looked at me with a noticeably pale expression and didn't respond.

"He finished signing in, grabbed his keys and left for his room."

Carlos added of the beast: "The creature appeared at least seven feet tall. It walked with a stoop, and the fur was long and seemed to flow as it walked.

"The fur was grey and black. I couldn't make out its face as I saw for only a second as I drove by."
